english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing an action that looks easy and requires little effort.

exampleSentences.english: They made doing the homework look effortless.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢做份功課做得好輕鬆。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 dak1 hou2 hing1 sung1

english.note: Use this when “carefree” emphasizes feeling relaxed, unpressured, or free from difficulty rather than having no worries at all.

exampleSentences.english: Today's work is light, so doing it feels carefree.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今日啲工作唔多，做起上嚟好輕鬆。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 gung1 zok3 m4 do1 zou6 hei2 soeng6 lai4 hou2 hing1 sung1

english.note: Use 輕鬆 when a task or duty is easy and not demanding.

exampleSentences.english: This homework is light and easy to do; I'll finish it in a little while.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢份功課做起上嚟好輕鬆，我一陣就做完。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 hei2 soeng6 lei4 hou2 hing1 sung1 ngo5 jat1 zan6 zau6 zou6 jyun4
